def get_max_triples(n):
    a = [i * i - i + 1 for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    count = 0

    # Count occurrences of a[i] % 3
    mod_count = [0, 0, 0]
    for value in a:
        mod_count[value % 3] += 1

    # Calculate the number of valid triples
    # Case 1: All three numbers have remainder 0 when divided by 3
    count += (mod_count[0] * (mod_count[0] - 1) * (mod_count[0] - 2)) // 6
    # Case 2: All three numbers have remainder 1 when divided by 3
    count += (mod_count[1] * (mod_count[1] - 1) * (mod_count[1] - 2)) // 6
    # Case 3: All three numbers have remainder 2 when divided by 3
    count += (mod_count[2] * (mod_count[2] - 1) * (mod_count[2] - 2)) // 6
    # Case 4: One from each remainder class
    count += mod_count[0] * mod_count[1] * mod_count[2]

    return count
